answer: A workable design: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The network ties the trellis to sunk effort, uses the summit as an corroborating signal, then requires a delta before any payout.
